title: AI flight incident: Hydraulic systems failed; pilot tested positive for psychoactive substance
content: An unsettling incident occurred when an Air India pilot's post-flight drug test returned a non-negative result for a psychoactive substance. The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau has identified this as a serious problem, calling for the Directorate General of Civil Aviation to respond urgently.

They allege Swatantra Bhardwaj assaulted protesters at Jantar Mantar during a peaceful demonstration. Bhardwaj himself admitted to the assault in a widely shared video online. title: High-risk delivery: Why 1 in 3 gig workers feels unsafe on Delhi roads

Customer harassment and abuse are also frequently reported incidents.  Workers receive insufficient safety training and lack adequate health support.  Extreme weather conditions further compound these considerable occupational hazards.

title: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith’s message to international students: Study, then return home
content: Alberta's Premier Danielle Smith has made it clear that international students need to leave Canada once their study visas expire. She highlighted that these visas serve as temporary permits meant for academic pursuits, urging students to return to their home countries. This statement follows rising concerns over immigration programs misleading students about potential residency outcomes. With Canada tightening its immigration policies, unauthorized work could lead to serious repercussions.

title: Valid train berth, midnight deboarding & lost job; Railways ordered to pay Rs 2 lakh

title: Meet 18-year-old ‘vibe coder’ who earns up to $15,000 a month from junk collection

This innovative pricing calculator allowed his crews to bid jobs accurately every time. Grandbois now coaches others interested in starting similar junk removal ventures. His business model has evolved from physical labor to selling business systems.

title: 'Encroacher' remark hangs over Yusuf Pathan as he withdraws land dispute appeal

Careful attention is being given to preserve original elements such as the floors and windows while integrating modern systems to enhance protection of the museum's collections. title: Left alone as last child, 3-year-old sexually assaulted by Navi Mumbai bus driver

The girl complained of abdominal pain to her grandmother, leading to the discovery.  Police confirmed the sexual assault after a medical examination of the child.  The accused driver was remanded in police custody by a Panvel court.

title: He failed 15 competitive exams before cracking CAT at 99.86 percentile

He eventually cleared SSC CGL and SBI PO in 2023, working as an SBI Probationary Officer for nearly two years. While balancing banking responsibilities, he resumed CAT preparation and scored 99.86 percentile in CAT 2025. His journey ultimately led to admission to IIM Ahmedabad, highlighting resilience, persistence and the value of adapting after failure.

title: Mumbai redevelopment market milestone: Housing sales overtake new project launches
content: report says more than 1,000 redevelopment projects have been launched since 2020 . the report said the market has transitioned from a commercial opportunity into an urban survival imperative . more than 13% of Mumbai’s residential supply has been redeveloped since 2020, according to the report .

title: 'Habibi, come to Iran': Tehran's Minesweeper dare for Uncle Sam over Hormuz
content: video shared by the Iranian embassy in Sierra Leone challenged the US to “come to Iran” with an animated minesweeper-style video set over the Strait of Hormuz . the post came after US forces had removed Iran-laid mines from the Straits of Horminuz and were continuing to move oil tankers through the key shipping route .

title: North Dakota ranch restores 270 acres to native grass as beavers return
content: John Lee and Ellen Njos have spent more than five decades showing that working land and conservation can go forward together . the couple has gradually changed how they graze, water and manage their land . they have now been awarded the 2026 North Dakota Leopold Conservation Award for their efforts .

title: 'Operation Economic Outcast': EU joins Trump's campaign to squeeze Iran
content: "the European Union has officially joined" the US-led "Operation Economic Outcast" treasury secretary Scott Bessent says the bloc has thrown its weight behind Donald Trump's economic campaign against Iran . the announcement comes as the EU signalled that it could support further economic measures against Tehran .

title: Isro's GSLV-F17 successfully places imaging satellite EOS-05 in geosynchronous orbit
content: ISRO’s GSLV-F17/EOS-05 mission successfully accomplished the mission . the 51.7-metre-tall, 420.5-tonne, three-stage rocket lifted off from the second launch pad at Sriharikota at 2.55am . it placed the around 2,367kg Earth observation satellite in its intended sub-geosynchronous transfer orbit .

title: Economic, military, or covert pressure? Vance on Trump's toolkit for dealing with Iran
content: vice president JD Vance keeps plans for Iran 'private' he says the administration has several options for dealing with the conflict . he said the administration will keep its plans private to preserve Donald Trump's flexibility in deciding how to respond . the conflict between Washington and Tehran continues to escalate .

title: Stadium erupts as match paused in Argentina to honour Lionel Messi - Watch
content: the first tribute came during the Copa Argentina match between Velez Sarsfield and Boca juniors . the match ended 0-0, with Boca Juniors winning the penalty shootout 4-3 . it follows a decision by the argentina football association .

title: 25 Pakistani military personnel killed in Balochistan attacks, BLA claims
content: the balochistan Liberation Army claims responsibility for two attacks . the militant group initially claimed that 18 personnel were killed in the attack, with the death toll rising to 25 . a one-minute-and-11-second video trailer shows armed fighters near burning Pakistani military vehicles .

title: IndiGo flight from Navi Mumbai hits pole at Srinagar airport during landing
content: an IndiGo flight from Navi Mumbai to Srinagar came into contact with a pole . all passengers and crew members on board were safe and no injuries were reported . the incident occurred during parking at the airport on friday morning .

title: Estonia minister quits after €70-million Ukraine shell deal involving Indian firm
content: the defence minister quits in a row over an arms deal to supply artillery shells to Ukraine . it emerged on Wednesday that Estonia had paid the amount upfront for the shells, but the Indian company Neco Defence Munitions involved had no previous record of selling ammunition . in 2024, Estonia signed a shell-supply deal with Italian-registered Datasel .

title: 'Heard voices': 2 workers make it out alive 9 days after Nepal floods hit tunnel
content: rescuers in Nepal pulled two workers alive from a tunnel at the Trishuli 3A hydropower project on friday . the two workers were pulled out in quick succession from inside the plant . they were pulling one man through a small opening in the ground and clapping as he emerged .
